name: The name a worker credential writes under is nobody else's
summary: actor_names.collision is the one rule for a worker credential's actor namespace: its head, case folded, must not be a name the project's tracker already holds as an author or assignee, a session actor of the project or a name of that shape, a name on the operator or verifier list, the web service's namespace (the one it was launched with, as well as http), or a look-alike that begins or ends with a dot or dash or carries an @host. The credential issue route asks the host through the backend's actor_standing (endpoint action actor-standing, one bd export when it asks for the rows) and answers 422 before anything is kept; a superuser may allow a row-held name with allow_actor. http_authority.descriptor_actor_denial makes the endpoint refuse at use any name without the shape of a web id that is not inside a worker credential's own, uncolliding namespace, judging a credential issued before the rule against the tracker rows older than its own issuance. http_service.InProcessBackend applies the same rule at use with what that backend knows. admin.py credential-actors lists existing credentials with the rule each breaks, reading only.
